description: Create an optimized SQL query file to fix a slow analytics report. In the workspace at /home/ga/workspace/analytics_db/, create a file named 'top_products_by_category.sql' that contains a SQL query to retrieve product sales data aggregated by category. The query must: (1) Join tables: orders, order_items, products, and categories using appropriate JOIN clauses (at least 3 JOINs), (2) Select columns with aliases: category name (as category_name), product name (as product_name), total quantity sold (as total_quantity using SUM), and total revenue (as total_revenue using SUM), (3) Include GROUP BY clause to group by category and product, (4) Include ORDER BY clause with DESC to sort by revenue, (5) Include LIMIT clause (e.g., LIMIT 100), (6) Format with SQL conventions: uppercase keywords (SELECT, FROM, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT), proper indentation for readability, (7) Add at least one comment using -- or /* */ syntax to explain the query purpose or business logic. Review the schema.txt file in the workspace for table structure details.
